text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 104,088 to 96,539, but this decline alone does not predict what prices will do next.","Because losses affect me strongly, I should focus on whether my overall risk is tolerable, not make fear-driven trades after a downturn.","I made no trades throughout these periods; I should continue to review my holdings occasionally and trade only for a clear reason, while remembering that inaction is also a choice."]}
